tagline: Classic Pong. You on the left, a friend on the right.
description:
A white ball, two paddles, a black court. On your own you play a computer opponent that gets sharper when it is behind and sloppier when it is winning. Send the invite and a friend takes the other paddle, on their phone or their computer — there is no game server, no account, and no lobby. The room is the link.

On a phone, drag your half of the screen, or hold the on-screen arrows. On a keyboard, Q and A move the left paddle, P and L the right. First to nine.

An unofficial port of Jake Gordon's JavaScript Pong, MIT-licensed. This copy adds a friend on a second device, and touch.
